## (A) Top cluster-specific extracellular genes {#figs9a}

```{r figs9a-code, code=code_for("../script/FigureS9.R", "S9a"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r figs9a-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="90%"}
knitr::include_graphics("assets/ExtendedDataFigure9/S9a_heatmap_effector_GO0005615_top100.png")
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Extended Data Fig. 9A.** Heatmap showing log1p(CP10K) expression of the 100
most cluster-specific effector genes, defined as genes reaching at least 0.5
log1p CP10K in at least one immgenT cluster and ranked by the specificity score
used in Figure 8. Drawn from the 1,821-gene GO:0005615 (extracellular space)
list, of which 305 pass the expression filter; this is what distinguishes it
from [Figure 7a](Figure7.html#fig7a), which uses the 59-gene curated effector
list. Rows (genes) and columns (clusters) are ordered by hierarchical
clustering. Annotation bars indicate T-cell lineage and activation status
(resting versus activated).
:::
